quarterly_data.quarter: SUSS MicroTec press release: SUSS and Manz Asia Announce Strategic Collaboration in (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SUSS announced a strategic collaboration with Manz Asia to jointly develop next-generation inkjet solutions for semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging; SUSS contributes semiconductor process equipment and advanced packaging expertise, Manz Asia its inkjet capabilities and position in the emerging panel-level packaging ecosystem. SUSS says inkjet is a key pillar of its long-term growth strategy and is expected to become an increasingly important element of its coating business, and cites market assessments (SUSS Research, Yole) that the annual serviceable equipment market for semiconductor inkjet applications is expected to exceed USD 800 million by 2030. CEO Burkhardt Frick: the collaboration strengthens access to the panel-level packaging ecosystem, an area SUSS believes will play an increasingly important role, and supports the Ambition 2030 strategy.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor inkjet serviceable equipment market expected to exceed USD 800 million by 2030 (SUSS Research, Yole)
